description: Give another agent session a task you will check on. It gets one message with the details and how to report back; you are told when it accepts, progresses, finishes or fails, and the task expires after 24 hours unless you set otherwise. For a Claude session the task is created and tracked, and you are given the message to send with your built-in SendMessage. Say what done looks like in acceptance_criteria. Use risk high only for work that must not wait.

acceptance_criteria.description: How you will judge it done, for example which test must pass

details.description: Everything the assignee needs: context, file paths, constraints

on_behalf_of.description: The person this is for, if any

title.description: One line saying what to do

to.description: Assignee: session name, ref, or uds: address

name: send_task
title: Hand another session a tracked task
